spec_match.rationale: Covers the whole coordinated group Appendix A defines — all seven background-* longhands — plus the appendix's second normative observable, the shorthand's empty-string CSSOM serialisation under mismatched lists.

interactive.rationale: Image-count segment re-runs the whole table live; the serialise button executes the real getComputedStyle(box).background read and verdicts it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the seven-longhand table, the empty-string shorthand probe and a labelled mask comparison; all three are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Shows truncation targets changing with layer count (3→1 vs 3→2), the shorthand serialisation flip, and the neighbouring mask-position group clearly labelled as a comparison rather than part of this entry.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus and Appendix A; the code block quotes the normative shorthand sentence verbatim.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts per-longhand preservation (position/size/repeat), the empty-string shorthand rule, and the rendering-invariant check; verified 2 pass / 7 fail on Chromium 141 — every behavioural probe can fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP: table showed all seven longhands equalised (to 1 then to 2 after the segment click), the shorthand serialised NON-empty with the exact value shown, mask row equalised to 1 — all matching the ground-truth probes run before building; console clean; both viewports screenshot-verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe tier, cross-longhand consistency (all-7-or-none), and that the shorthand's emptiness agrees with the independence tier.

design_system.rationale: Table and verdict colours use design-system variables (emerald-dark/rose on light cells); the stage gradients use accent variables with no text on them.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with caption and th scopes inside a focusable labelled scroll region, native buttons at 44px, stage has role=img description, single polite readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The wide table scrolls inside its labelled wrapper while the page itself has no horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Capture the all-preserved table and empty shorthand on Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 158 the table should read 7/7 preserved and the serialise button should print "" (empty string). Only the equalised side could execute here; confirm the preserved side and the shorthand-serialisation-matches-tier assert on a real 158 build.

openQuestions.title: Pin down whether mask-* ships in the same Chrome 158 change
openQuestions.detail: The chromestatus entry lists css-masking parsing WPTs but names only background-*. The lab's mask-position row will answer this empirically on 158 — record whether mask follows in the same milestone and, if so, consider a small additive mask-focused concept.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Scroll-region and table semantics not inspected in the accessibility tree; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide tables in a scrollable, keyboard-reachable region instead of overflowing the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .tablewrap has overflow-x auto, tabindex=0, role=region with an aria-label that names the horizontal scroll.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics caption and header scope
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use caption and th scope=col/row on data tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The table carries a caption, column th scopes, and row th scopes for each longhand name.

guidanceConsulted.query: mobile-safe sizing of a painted lab stage
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid viewport-unit heights for embedded stages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The lab box is 5rem tall, intrinsic width.

summary: Seven-longhand lab verified on Chromium 141 headless: every row equalised exactly as ground-truth predicted at both layer counts, the shorthand serialised non-empty with its value printed, the mask comparison row behaved identically — all honestly verdicted as pre-158. Console clean, both viewports pass. The 7/7-preserved and empty-string outcomes await Chrome 158.
